before.body:
Preserves independent identity while adding Bonvoy and Marriott commercial infrastructure
Suited to conversion of boutique, lifestyle, and resort assets with clear local point of view
Supports premium positioning when market tier and operating complexity fit full-service underwriting
Owners should model franchise fees, PIP scope, loyalty economics, and ramp timing explicitly—not assume automatic uplift
Operator fit matters: strongest with teams that can deliver design-forward full-service or resort operations, Marriott systems cutover, and ongoing collection QA.

after.body:
Preserves independent identity while adding Bonvoy and Marriott commercial infrastructure
Suited to conversion of boutique, lifestyle, and resort assets with clear local point of view
Supports premium positioning when market tier and operating complexity fit full-service underwriting
Owners should model franchise fees, PIP scope, loyalty economics, and ramp timing explicitly—not assume automatic uplift
Operator fit matters: strongest with teams that can deliver design-forward full-service or resort operations, Marriott systems cutover, and ongoing collection QA.

before.body:
PIP scope and timing can dominate conversion economics
Full-service complexity may exceed limited-service underwriting
Loyalty and franchise fees require explicit net contribution modeling
Heritage and design constraints can extend timeline and disrupt ramp-year NOI
Collection affiliation is not a one-time reflag; owners should plan for ongoing QA, systems participation, and brand-standard upkeep through the hold period.
